dependencies.acquisition: Initial network acquisition performed narrowly; all verification commands below ran with CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true.

derived_projection.authority: Git/filesystem exact source remains authoritative; structural SQLite rows are disposable derived state.
derived_projection.rebuild: Schema-version, schema-fingerprint, or parser-fingerprint mismatch drops structural metadata/files/symbols/edges and rebuilds from current exact source fingerprints.
derived_projection.freshness: Every structural query preflights the complete supported-source manifest, including Git-ignored files; candidate paths are re-read and digest-validated before return; and the full supported-source manifest is revalidated after the query even for zero-hit results. Source races retry at most 2 times then fail closed.

incremental_refresh.rule: Reparse changed supported files plus only previously indexed import/module/test neighbors whose targets/stem family match changed/deleted modules; unrelated files are excluded.
incremental_refresh.unsupported_language: Returns StructuralLookup::UnsupportedLanguage so callers can use exact/lexical fallback; no guessed parse is attempted.

verification.tests: 1 structural unit regression + 8/8 structural integration tests

verification.evidence: Current-tree snapshot and telemetry emitted: 5 supported files, 1 unsupported file, 7 symbols, 4 dependency edges, max_live_asts=1, peak_source_bytes=92, peak_process_rss_bytes=8683520.
